adjudication.rationale: In the newly added webhook handler (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts), the code does a non-atomic read-then-write: it calls prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId: appMetadata.slug } }) and then conditionally prisma.credential.update(...) or prisma.credential.create(...). This pattern is race-prone under concurrent webhook deliveries: two requests can both observe no row and both attempt create, potentially producing duplicates if the DB schema does not enforce uniqueness, or causing an unhandled unique-violation error if it does. Additionally, using findFirst with no orderBy means that if duplicates already exist, an arbitrary row may be updated. The diff does not show any transaction or upsert to make this atomic.
